final: SELECT AVG(s3.avg_ratio) as result_col1, AVG(s3.distinct_zones) as result_col2, AVG(s3.diff) as result_col3 FROM (SELECT s1.healtheval, s1.avg_ratio, s1.distinct_zones, s1.avg_ratio - s2.overall_avg as diff FROM (SELECT sites.healtheval, AVG(CASE WHEN scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin != 0 THEN CAST(scans.gbsize AS REAL) / scans.spanmin ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN scans.zoneref IS NOT NULL THEN scans.zoneref ELSE NULL END) as distinct_zones FROM scans JOIN sites ON sites.zoneregistry = scans.zoneref GROUP BY sites.healtheval) s1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(subq.avg_ratio) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT sites.healtheval, AVG(CASE WHEN scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin != 0 THEN CAST(scans.gbsize AS REAL) / scans.spanmin ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM scans JOIN sites ON sites.zoneregistry = scans.zoneref GROUP BY sites.healtheval) subq) s2 WHERE s1.avg_ratio > s2.overall_avg AND s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL) s3
